svg.title: Index Translator browser components, requests
svg.desc: The page's main module builds the translation request. The request module builds the body from the form, or the image's when the source is an image, and the glossary module parses the glossary. The model selector picks the model by the text's length. The main module posts the request to the server and reads its event stream through the resume module, which reconnects after a cut. The state and render modules update the page. Server errors are described by the API module. a request: public/app.ts → Server API. choose the model: public/app.ts → public/request.ts → public/select-model.ts.

g.text: wires the page, sends the request
builds the body, text or image
